from build123d import *
import math

plate_width = 80.0
plate_length = 80.0
plate_thickness = 9.6
central_hole_dia = 26.7
hole_dia = 12.4
hole_pattern_radius = 30.0
hole_count = 8
connector_hole_dia = 11.7
connector_rows = 4
connector_cols = 4
connector_spacing = 20.0

solid = Box(plate_width, plate_length, plate_thickness)
solid = solid - Cylinder(central_hole_dia / 2, plate_thickness)

for i in range(hole_count):
    angle = math.radians(i * 360.0 / hole_count)
    px = hole_pattern_radius * math.cos(angle)
    py = hole_pattern_radius * math.sin(angle)
    solid = solid - Pos(px, py, 0) * Cylinder(hole_dia / 2, plate_thickness)

for i in range(connector_cols):
    for j in range(connector_rows):
        x = (i - (connector_cols - 1) / 2) * connector_spacing
        y = (j - (connector_rows - 1) / 2) * connector_spacing
        solid = solid - Pos(x, y, 0) * Cylinder(connector_hole_dia / 2, plate_thickness)

part = solid
part.name = "plate_with_holes"
export_step(part, "output.step")
